title: Sailing at the 1984 Summer Olympics – 470
summary: This partial document covers the 470 class sailing event at the 1984 Summer Olympics held in Long Beach, Los Angeles County, California. It provides an overview of the competition, noting that seven races were scheduled with 56 sailors competing on 28 boats representing 28 nations. The document includes a Results section with a legend explaining competition abbreviations such as DNF (Did Not Finish), DNS (Did Not Start), DSQ (Disqualified), PMS (Premature Start), and YMP (Yacht Materially Prejudiced), as well as gender markers for competitors. It also references a Daily Standings section, though the actual results tables appear to be omitted from this partial text. The document concludes with Notes and References sections, citing sources including the Official Report Los Angeles 1984 (Volumes 1 and 2) edited by Richard B. Perelman, the Sports-Reference.com Olympics database, and a publication on Canada's Olympic Sailing Legacy by Hugh Drake and Paul Henderson.
